description: WSO2 SAP Successfactors Skills Management provides a way to interact with the [SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central APIs](https://api.sap.com/package/SuccessFactorsEmployeeCentral/overview). The service allows to manage employee skills, competencies, job profiles, and skills-related assessments.
key-features: Manage employee skills profiles and competency frameworks
Access certification content and skill assessments
Query talent tracking and development records
